name: Milnacipran
metabolism: mostly excreted unchanged in urine. routes through the body include glucuronide conjugation and N-desethylation; the resulting metabolites are also cleared mainly by the kidneys.
summary: Milnacipran is a serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor used to treat fibromyalgia, major depressive disorder, and neuropathic pain. Its approved indications vary by country.
